items.title: Pete Candoli interviewed by Monk Rowe, Los Angeles, California, February 15, 1999
items.q: I had a little 78 of “Patricia,” and I’m trying to tell the music teacher, like we’d always march in the classrooms on Haydn

ctx.x: Your ear must have been getting some really good training between the off-beats on the peck horn and the string bass.

Yeah it was quite amazing. I remember coming into the eighth grade and I had a little 78 of “Patricia,” and I’m trying to tell the music teacher, like we’d always march in the classrooms on Haydn [scats]. But I was really amazed. I said, “Don’t you hear what’s happening?” I would tell her, “Can’t you hear these sounds?” I mean it killed me then. I was in the eighth grade. And so, “Well yes, that’s very nice, Walter,” that’s my real name is Walter, see? And I said okay. It didn’t give her a charge. And I just got…
